Weight & Age Restrictions Passengers must be at least 7 years of age and weigh 40 pounds or more.
Total weight per seat shall not exceed 275 lbs.
For groups of 3 passengers, no more than one person can be 200+lbs, with a total passenger weight not to exceed 560lbs.
